camera.checkSubtitle: Place your device on a stable surface before opening the live camera.
camera.stable: Place the device securely at a comfortable height.
camera.visible: Keep your body and the required joints in view.
camera.lighting: Use even lighting and a clear background.
camera.privacy: The camera picture stays in this browser. Nothing from this check is saved or sent.
camera.setupFigure: A device on a stable stand facing a person whose whole body is in view
camera.previewOnly: Camera preview only. No exercise measurements are recorded.
camera.allowHelp: Your browser will ask to use the camera. The picture stays on this device.
camera.blocked: The camera is blocked for this site.
camera.blockedHelp: Open your browser's site settings (the camera or lock icon beside the address), allow the camera, then try again.
camera.noCamera: No camera was found. Connect a camera, or use the phone app.
camera.inUse: The camera is in use by another app or tab. Close it, then try again.
camera.unavailable: This camera is unavailable. Try another camera.
camera.loadingHelp: This takes a few seconds the first time, then the browser keeps it.
camera.trackingFailed: This browser cannot load body tracking. Use the phone app for the camera exercise.
camera.analysisFailed: Camera analysis is unavailable. Go back and retry.
camera.hiddenPause: Measuring stops while this tab is in the background, and starts again when you come back.
camera.slow: Tracking is slow. Close other tabs and apps. This warning is not a clinical eligibility result.
camera.description: Camera preview with visible body landmarks. {{focus}}. Highlighted joints identify the assigned visual focus; they do not certify correct movement.
camera.focusMeasurement: Movement assessment: {{joint}}. The highlighted part is visual guidance.
camera.focusNotVisible: The assigned focus part is not clearly visible. Reposition to bring it into view.
camera.position: Keep the required joints visible. Your skeleton appears when tracking is available.
camera.legend: Highlighted: assigned focus part · Muted: other visible joints

quality.NO_PERSON: No person detected. Position your body in view.
quality.MULTIPLE_PEOPLE: More than one person detected. Keep only the patient in view.
quality.LOW_CONFIDENCE: Required joints are not clearly visible. Reposition.
quality.OUT_OF_FRAME: Keep the required joints inside the camera view.
quality.DEGENERATE: Joint geometry is unreliable. Adjust the camera view.
quality.POSITIONING: Hold your position while tracking stabilizes.
quality.TRUNK_LEAN: Keep your upper body straight. Leaning too far stops the repetition from counting.
quality.READY: Tracking ready. Use a controlled movement.

calc.title: How repetitions are counted
calc.gaugeDescription: {{joint}} angle gauge. Current {{current}}. Start zone up to {{low}} degrees, target from {{high}} degrees. Session range {{range}}.
calc.rule: A repetition counts when the {{joint}} angle starts at {{low}}° or less, reaches {{high}}° or more, stays there for {{hold}}, then comes back to {{low}}° or less. One repetition must take between {{shortest}} and {{longest}}.
calc.sourceDemo: Demo thresholds · not a therapist prescription
calc.legend: Dashed line: 0° reference · Arc: measured angle · Grey band: start zone · Green band: target zone

session.title: Today's exercise
session.notFound: This exercise is no longer assigned to you, or it has changed. Go back to your exercises and open it again.
session.loadFailed: The exercise could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
session.consent: I consent to saving movement summaries to my rehabilitation account. No landmarks or camera pictures are stored.
session.statusPreview: Preview only · repetitions are not counting
session.statusPaused: Measurement paused · repetitions are not counting
session.startHelp: Allow saving below, wait for tracking ready, then select Start measurement. A visible skeleton alone does not start a session.
session.resumeHelp: Wait for tracking ready, then select Resume measurement. Return to the starting position before beginning a new repetition.
session.trackingWait: Tracking is not ready. Reposition as directed; unreliable movement is not counted.
session.returnTo: Now go back to {{degrees}}° or less. The repetition counts when you get back there.
session.reach: Move to {{degrees}}° or more and hold it for {{hold}}. Then go back to the start.
session.reachNoHold: Move to {{degrees}}° or more, then go back to the start.
session.startRefused: Measurement did not start because tracking was lost. Stay in view until tracking is ready, then select Start again.
session.consentFailed: Your consent could not be saved. Check your connection, then select Start again.
session.getInView: Step into view to start the {{side}}.
session.saved: Saved to your account. Your therapist can see it in your progress.
session.failed: Not saved yet. Check your connection and try again. Keep this page open until it is saved.
session.nothingMeasured: Nothing was measured, so nothing was saved.
session.privacy: The camera picture stays in this browser. Only the movement summary you allow is saved.

coach.notRecording: Not counting yet. Select Start measurement below.
coach.tracking: Waiting for tracking. Stay in view of the camera.
coach.start: Go to the start: {{degrees}}° or less
coach.return: Now go back to {{degrees}}° or less to count it
coach.missedRange: Not counted. Reach the target and hold it before coming back.
coach.missedFast: Not counted. Move a little slower.
coach.missedSlow: Not counted. That took too long, so start again.
coach.voiceTextOnly: This browser has no voice for this language, so the feedback is shown here as text.
coach.finishHelp: A short tune and a word of encouragement when you finish

cue.missedRange: Try again. Reach the target and hold it.
cue.targetReached: Target reached. Keep going until the time is up.
